name: skills-directory
description: Curated catalog of portable agent skills. Install any one as a Claude Code plugin, no manual copying.

plugins.name: mod
plugins.description: End-to-end build/fix/ship harness — takes a repo from its current state to shipped, tested, documented, and demonstrable, all inside WSL. Invoke as `Mod:` followed by a repo link.

plugins.name: grimoire
plugins.description: Generate or modify a full app from a plain-English description and push it to a private GitHub repo (with an IMP_DOCS/ folder), via the Grimoire / AppBuilder MCP tools or CLI. Bring-your-own-keys. Say `Grimoire, build me …`.

plugins.name: code-translator
plugins.description: Translates code between programming languages while preserving exact logical equivalence. Trigger when the user asks to translate, port, or convert code between languages.

plugins.name: claude-assassin
plugins.description: Silent background daemon (Windows/macOS/Linux) that saves task state on a Claude Code session limit and auto-relaunches the moment the reset timer expires. Install once, works forever.

plugins.name: supply-chain-prober
plugins.description: Conducts conversational supply chain interviews with non-technical users, collects structured data, and routes it to SMEs for validation before handing off to the tech team for agent building.
